item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00127","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C06","C23","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":"C06","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C06 is a strong drafting template. Both directives first establish a named board, specify a mobilization official as chairman and a fixed set of additional members, then define advisory functions concerning a defense program. Most decisively, the child's final provision closely reproduces C06's distinctive two-part meeting clause, while the child's duty to advise the President \"from time to time\" also tracks C06. C23 and C03 plausibly informed the child's civil-defense substance—integrated Federal planning, consideration of military requirements, and interagency coordination—but their overall drafting structures are less directly replicated.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"There is hereby established a Civil Defense Coordinating Board, hereinafter referred to as the Board... composed of the Administrator of the Federal Civil Defense Administration, who shall be the Chairman of the Board, and seventeen other members","parent_excerpt":"There is hereby established the National Advisory Board on Mobilization Policy, hereinafter referred to as the Board, which shall be composed of the Director of Defense Mobilization, as Chairman, and sixteen other members","explanation":"The child closely follows C06's establishment-and-composition formula, adapting the board name, chairman, membership count, and method of selecting members."},{"child_excerpt":"To advise the President from time to time with respect to the progress of the integration of civil-defense activities","parent_excerpt":"It shall be the function of the Board to advise the President from time to time with respect to the current defense mobilization program or any phase thereof.","explanation":"This is a close functional and verbal parallel assigning periodic presidential advice concerning progress in a defense-related program."},{"child_excerpt":"The Board shall meet with the President at his request, and shall meet at such other times as may be determined by its Chairman.","parent_excerpt":"The Board shall meet with the President at his request and shall meet at such other times as may be determined by its Chairman.","explanation":"The meeting provision is essentially verbatim and is distinctive enough to show direct reuse of C06's drafting."}]}
